ryans.name: Ryan Richter
ryans.title: American soccer coach and former professional player; interim head coach of the Philadelphia Union of Major League Soccer
ryans.lead_summary: **Ryan Richter** (born April 12, 1989) is an American soccer coach and former professional player who is the interim head coach of the Philadelphia Union of Major League Soccer [1][2]. He was named to the role on May 27, 2026, when the Union were last in MLS at 1-10-4 [2][3]. Under Richter the team went unbeaten in 15 straight league matches (12 wins, 3 draws) after the 2026 FIFA World Cup break and clinched a 2026 MLS Cup Playoffs berth on October 28, 2026 [4][5].
known_for: Taking over a 1-10-4 Philadelphia Union in May 2026 and leading a franchise-record 15-game MLS unbeaten run
Union clinching a 2026 MLS Cup Playoffs berth on Oct 28, 2026
